Special bodies: `NoVersion` — `{error: "no such version"}`; `MountedPage` — `{detail, error: "is mounted"}`; `NotPlaced` — `{reason}`. 400/408/413 describe a read refusal, `error` — `denied` (GP-L03, the decision of the Architect 2026-10-28); the body is bounded by the bytes actually received, a short one gives 400. `/session` GET to an anonymous caller gives 200 with the state; a bad POST attempt — 401, the open mode — 400, a wrong password of the emergency login — 401, no emergency account — 403 (chapter 6.3 N4; review of stage A 8–10, № 41).
